Nora P: nightly linkcheck blew up, a bunch of broken fragment links from the new migration guide. failing anchors look like "#how-it-works?" and "#config:examples" Nora P: example log -> ``` Linkcheck: broken fragment: /docs/migration#how-it-works? -> expected #how-it-works Linkcheck: broken fragment: /docs/config#examples -> expected #config-examples ``` Diego M: I bet punctuation in headings (question marks, colons) and parentheses are being stripped differently by mkdocs vs docusaurus slugifiers. saw this before with emoji too :thinking_face: Sasha V: quick repro: `### How it works?` -> mkdocs slug `how-it-works` but docusaurus sometimes keeps trailing punctuation if the slugifier version is old. Nora P: we have a mix of include plugins that transform headings inside snippets which makes it worse (generated headings keep raw punctuation). Diego M: short fixes: - normalize headings in source (strip trailing punctuation) - add explicit html anchors where necessary `

Config: examples

` - update our slugifier lib to a consistent version across build pipelines Sasha V: I prefer updating slugifier + a linter that warns on punctuation in headings. small script to find offending headings: ```bash rg "^#{1,6}.*[\?\:\(\)\!]$" docs/ -n || true ``` Nora P: can someone throw together a tiny PR that normalizes heading punctuation and adds tests for a few edge cases (emoji, ellipsis, parentheses)? Diego M: on it. I'll add a unit test file `tests/test_slugify.py` with cases: `("How it works?", "how-it-works")`, `("Config: examples", "config-examples")`, `("Load (beta)", "load-beta")`, `("Examples…", "examples")` infra-bot: CI job docs/linkcheck queued for pull/8501 Nora P: also please include a note in CONTRIBUTING.md: "avoid Unicode punctuation in headings; prefer plain ASCII or explicit frontmatter slug" Diego M: pushing draft PR 8501 now with normalization script and tests. snippet: ```python import re from pathlib import Path for p in Path('docs').rglob('*.md'): s = p.read_text(encoding='utf8') s2 = re.sub(r"(#+\s+.+?)\s+[\?\:\(\)\!\u2026]+\\n", r"\1\\n", s) if s!=s2: p.write_text(s2, encoding='utf8') print('normalized', p) ``` reviewer-bot: PR 8501 created by Diego M (draft) — checks: lint, tests reviewer-bot: docs/linkcheck (pull/8501) failed — 3 remaining mismatches; see https://ci.example.com/reds/9999/logs/12 Sasha V: logs show two mismatches from READMEs included from external repos; they have headings with parentheses in codeblocks. I'll update the include preprocessor to run the same normalization over included content. Diego M: updated PR with include-preproc normalization; retesting. infra-bot: docs/linkcheck (pull/8501) passed ✅ Nora P: great — can we also add a nightly alert rule: if linkcheck fails with >5 broken fragments, send #docs and open an issue automatically? filed infra ticket: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/472 Sasha V: +1. leaving a followup to audit older pages for odd punctuation. Diego M: merging PR 8501 after squash-merge. thanks all :shipit:
